description: This file defines the CachedCatalogViewModelService class, which implements ICatalogViewModelService. It provides cached access to catalog data such as brands, types, and catalog items, using in-memory caching to optimize performance.

classes.name: CachedCatalogViewModelService
classes.description: A service class that caches catalog-related data (brands, types, items) to improve retrieval performance.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Retrieves a list of brands, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Retrieves catalog items based on pagination and filters, utilizing cache.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of catalog types, utilizing cache.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Asynchronous method that returns a list of brand selection items, with caching.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Asynchronous method that returns catalog items with specified parameters, with caching.

methods.name: GetTypes
